hazards.control: Certified lifting gear; no one under the injector while it is suspended.
Hands clear of the injector chains, the reel, and the stripper door.
Stay clear of the coil path, the gooseneck, and flowback iron under flow.

name: Injector head frame
function: The machine that pushes the coil into the well and pulls it out: a frame with two counter-rotating chains carrying gripper blocks that clamp the coil, hydraulic motors, a skate and tension system, and a load cell that reads pipe weight.

tabs.overview: Pull and snub ratings (thousands of pounds in each direction) set what coil and what wellhead pressure the unit can handle; gripper blocks are sized to the coil; the load cell drives the weight indicator in the cabin.
tabs.engineering: Pull classes of 60,000 to 100,000 lb are common; hydraulic drive from the power pack.
tabs.safety: Suspended by the crane or mast; the chain and block area is a pinch hazard; the coil between the reel and gooseneck is a line-of-fire hazard.
tabs.evidence: Public coiled tubing pressure control guide (S24), API RP 16ST and API RP 5C7 scope (S23, S26), field practice (S9).
